title: Button states
author: @lunokjod
description: Nine buttons, each one a different way of saying what a control is: enabled, disabled while it is built, disabled on the second page, `dim` given and not given, a grey colour on an enabled button. It is the bench where the tone of a disabled button is looked at on the glass, because a page of another app says whether it works only if it says which of the nine it was.
